fix.explanation: Arvind Panagariya chaired the 16th Finance Commission. Its award covers 2026-27 to 2030-31 and keeps the States' share of the divisible pool of central taxes at 41%, the same as the 15th Finance Commission, which was chaired by N.K. Singh.
